qanat_system_1 = { #Cisterns

	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		culture = { has_cultural_parameter = unlocks_qanat_building }
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_farmed_early_medieval_trigger = yes
		NOR = {
			terrain = floodplains
			terrain = wetlands
			terrain = taiga
			terrain = forest
			terrain = jungle
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_modifier = {
		prosperity_growth = 0.02
		trade_category_cereals_production_mult = 0.25
		trade_good_cotton_production_mult = 0.25
		trade_good_flax_production_mult = 0.25
		trade_good_sugar_production_mult = 0.25
	}
	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = dryland_dwellers_irrigation_network_bonuses
		agricultural_tax_mult = 0.02
		stationed_light_cavalry_maintenance_low_modifier = -0.02
		stationed_camel_cavalry_maintenance_low_modifier = -0.02
	}
	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = waterworks_agricultural_bonuses
		agricultural_tax_mult = 0.01
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = qanat_system_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/qanats.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		modifier = {
			add = 1
			OR = {
				#Counters penalties in regions with evaporation
				terrain = mountains
				terrain = desert_mountains
				terrain = desert
				terrain = drylands
				terrain = steppe
			}
		}
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_cultural_unlock_building_modifier = { PARAMETER = unlocks_qanat_building }
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}

}

cooper_workshop_1 = {

	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		OR = {
			production_of_trade_good_type = {
				target = trade_good_type:trade_good_wine
				value > 0
			}
			production_of_trade_good_type = {
				target = trade_good_type:trade_good_beer
				value > 0
			}
			production_of_trade_good_type = {
				target = trade_good_type:trade_good_fish
				value > 0
			}
			production_of_trade_good_type = {
				target = trade_good_type:trade_good_oil
				value > 0
			}
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = cooper_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = cooper_income_tier_1_tribal
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_wood_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_wine_production_mult = cooper_multiplier_per_wood_need
				trade_good_beer_production_mult = cooper_multiplier_per_wood_need
				trade_good_fish_production_mult = cooper_multiplier_per_wood_need
				trade_good_oil_production_mult = cooper_multiplier_per_wood_need
				trade_good_honey_production_mult = cooper_multiplier_per_wood_need
				artisan_tax_mult = tax_mult_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = cooper_workshop_2
	type_icon = "old_buildings/workshops.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_wood }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}

}

cattle_tannery_1 = {

	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 3
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		NOT = { rite = { rite_has_parameter = leather_forbidden } }
		production_of_trade_good_type = {
			target = trade_good_type:trade_good_cattle
			value > 0
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = leather_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = leather_income_tier_1_tribal
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_cattle_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_wood_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_cattle
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_leather_production_add = tannery_leather_output_per_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_leather_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_leather_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_leather_production_mult = tanning_leather_mult_per_wood_need
				artisan_tax_mult = tax_mult_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = cattle_tannery_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/tannery.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_leather }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_cattle CATEGORY = trade_category_beasts_of_burden }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_wood }
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_leather }
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}

}

            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active

            }
        }
    }

		monthly_artisan_tax = leather_income_tier_3
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = leather_income_tier_3_tribal
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_wool_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_salt_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_alum_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_wood_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wool
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 3
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_leather_production_add = tannery_leather_output_per_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_leather_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {

			}
		}

		trade_good = trade_good_salt
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_leather_production_mult = 0.5
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal

			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal

			target = trade_good_type:trade_good_furs
			value > 0
		}
	
            }
        }
    }

        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }

            }

		monthly_artisan_tax = leather_income_tier_1
	}

		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = leather_income_tier_1_tribal

		trade_good_wood_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1

			}
		}

				trade_good_leather_production_mult = tanning_leather_mult_per_wood_need

	construction_time = construction_time_2_years
	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 5
        if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active } value = 0 }
    }
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		NOT = { rite = { rite_has_parameter = leather_forbidden } }
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {

            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_4_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = leather_income_tier_4
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = leather_income_tier_4_tribal
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_furs_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_salt_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_alum_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_wood_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_furs
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 4
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_leather_production_add = tannery_leather_output_per_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_leather_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_leather_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_salt
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_leather_production_mult = 0.5
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_leather_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_leather_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_alum
		amount = luxury_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_leather_production_mult = 0.5
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_leather_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_leather_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_leather_production_mult = tanning_leather_mult_per_wood_need
				artisan_tax_mult = tax_mult_per_production_need
			}
		}

	}

		ai_income_building_modifier = yes

	district_level_requirement = {
        value = 5

    }

        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		production_of_trade_good_type = {
			target = trade_good_type:trade_good_textiles #Lump/Rag Paper
			value > 0
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		#Papermaking Innovation
	
            }
        }
    }

            }

		monthly_artisan_tax = paper_income_tier_1
	}

		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = paper_income_tier_1_tribal

			}

		}
